name: Manchester United 1995/96
scopeNote: Focused run to check the Squad-axis (bas) anchor: only squad-building (and the manager's stated view, when found) was researched. Every other dimension is a gap, not evidence of absence. Partial dates: exact first and last match dates were not verified.

sources.title: 1995/96 Season Review
sources.evidence: United surprised by "selling established first-team trio Paul Ince, Andrei Kanchelskis and Mark Hughes" with no major signings; Ferguson "threw a host of academy stars into the fold" (Beckham, Scholes, the Nevilles, Butt became regular starters). Hansen on Match of the Day: "You can't win anything with kids." Title won by four points.

confidence.reason: Only squad-building researched; one official tier A source.
